subject: Project identity is an authorization boundary

body.failure_class: Recovering agents can operate on the wrong project when recent context, a newer handoff, an open repository, or previous-agent state is treated as writable authority before project identity is revalidated.
body.lesson: RECENT CONTEXT IS NOT PROJECT AUTHORITY.
body.package_requirement: Identity artifacts, exact source revision, current agent-spawn policy, and identity hashes must be present and pass generated-package readback verification.
regression_cases: stale/newer foreign-project context while BenefitFlow is explicitly selected
